output.question: What acquisitions has Johnson & Johnson made?
output.answer: J&J's most recent acquisition is Firefly Bio, a degrader antibody conjugate oncology company. J&J closed it on July 29, 2026 for $1 billion in cash, accounted for it as an asset acquisition and expects an IPR&D charge of about $1 billion in Q3 2026. Earlier in 2026, J&J agreed on April 24 to buy Atraverse Medical, which makes the HOTWIRE transseptal access system for AFib ablation, on undisclosed terms; J&J says the deal closed in Q2 2026. Before that, J&J completed the $3.05 billion cash purchase of Halda Therapeutics (RIPTAC platform, prostate cancer drug HLD-0915) on December 29, 2025, and closed the Intra-Cellular Therapies deal (CAPLYTA) on April 2, 2025, reported at $14.6 billion or $132 per share. The October 13, 2026 Q3 earnings release mentions no newer acquisitions, and I found no J&J acquisition announced in October or November 2026. The Sail Biomedicines deal is a collaboration, not an acquisition.

key_facts.fact: J&J completed its acquisition of Firefly Bio, Inc. on July 29, 2026 for $1 billion in cash. It is accounted for as an asset acquisition with an IPR&D charge of about $1 billion in Q3 2026 and adjusted EPS dilution of about $0.46 in 2026.
J&J agreed to acquire Atraverse Medical (HOTWIRE RF transseptal access system) on undisclosed terms. A later update on the page says the acquisition was completed in Q2 2026.
The Q3 2026 earnings release names Firefly Bio as an acquisition and describes Sail Biomedicines as a strategic collaboration, not an acquisition.
J&J completed its $3.05 billion cash acquisition of Halda Therapeutics OpCo, Inc. (RIPTAC platform), accounted for as a business combination.
J&J closed the Intra-Cellular Therapies acquisition, which brought in CAPLYTA (lumateperone) and ITI-1284.
The Intra-Cellular deal was valued at $14.6 billion, or $132.00 per share in cash.

successfully completed the acquisition of Atraverse Medical, Inc. in Q2 2026
Johnson & Johnson Announces Collaboration with Sail Biomedicines to Advance in vivo CAR-T Programs
accounted for as a business combination
Johnson & Johnson acquired all outstanding shares of Intra-Cellular Therapies for a payment of $132.00 per share in cash.

caveats: This covers recent deals only. Older major acquisitions (Shockwave Medical, V-Wave, Ambrx and Proteologix in 2024; Abiomed in 2022) come from search snippets or background knowledge, were not checked on opened pages, and are left out of key_facts.
The Atraverse page has both the original 'expected to close in Q2 2026' wording and a later 'completed in Q2 2026' update. No exact closing date was found.
Sail Biomedicines is a collaboration. One search snippet mentioned an option to acquire Sail for $2.6 billion, but I did not verify this on an opened page.
I found no J&J acquisition announced in October or November 2026, but a deal could have been announced that searches didn't surface.
The Kenvue acquisition that completed on November 2, 2026 is not a J&J deal. Kenvue is J&J's former consumer health unit, spun off in 2023.
